name: Banja Luka Cube Day 2023

venue.name: Sportska dvorana ,,STARČEVICA"
venue.address: Bulevar vojvode Stepe Stepanovića 116, Banja Luka 78000, Bosnia & Herzegovina

information: This is the 9th WCA competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The competition is open to all persons from all countries. There will be certificates for all competitors in top 3 of an event. ================ Ovo je 9. WCA takmičenje u Bosni i Hercegovini. Takmičenje je otvoreno za sve osobe iz svih zemalja. Za sve takmičare u prva 3 mjesta biće dodeljeni sertifikati.
